Everything's in place. Here's a summary:

**Lesson 0001 — Context and memory** (`lessons/0001-context-and-memory.html`, 30 min, objective O3)
Traces one makerspace-assistant request end to end so you can say exactly where each piece of info lives: in the context window for one call, resent each step within a session, saved to a file across sessions, or pulled in by retrieval. Covers the context window, tokens, context rot, sessions, retrieval, and notes — all tied to your laser cutter / drill press / 3D printer assistant, with worked + faded practice and two diagrams. Went through two reviewer passes (findings fixed both times — an uncited cost claim, option positions that never varied, a missing term definition, section-time labels that didn't add up to 30, and a bit more warmth per your preferences); the full record is in `review-records/0001-lesson.md`.

**Quiz ready:** `quizzes/0002.json` — 5 fresh items on O3, none repeating the lesson's practice questions. Ask when you want to check what stuck; I won't give answers away here.

**Also added:** a one-page cheat sheet (`cheatsheets/context-and-memory.html`) for quick lookup later, and sources logged in `RESOURCES.md`.
